matrixConvention.row: weft index from top to bottom
matrixConvention.column: warp index from left to right

edgeAcceptanceRules.shortStrip: Any trimmed visible strip segment shorter than 2*pitchMm must be flagged for manual reinforcement review.
edgeAcceptanceRules.squareHole: No open half-hole may terminate unsecured at the final edge; edge cells must be captured by the edge finish.
edgeAcceptanceRules.corner: At polygon or lobe valleys, strips intersecting the edge within one strip width of the corner require reinforcement flagging.
edgeAcceptanceRules.status: engineering checks only; thresholds remain pending physical validation
